description: I'm Jana Gamal from Egypt, passionate about space and what lies beyond the mysteries. I'm a web developer, content writer, scientific researcher, and graphic designer.
summary: Space Ghost Radio is an interactive, bilingual web control room that engages school age students by transforming deep space missions into a cosmic mystery where they tune radio frequencies, inspect 3D spacecraft models, and listen to audio diaries. The platform pairs each spacecraft with an onboard Astronaut Guide to explain the astrophysics and engineering behind historic missions i, merging human emotion.
details:
• Gamified Cosmic Storytelling: Space Ghost Radio is an interactive, retro-futuristic web control room designed to bring NASA's silent, abandoned, and deep-space missions back to life

• Anthropomorphic Narrative: Instead of treating historic hardware as forgotten debris, our game gives a voice to narrate their own journeys, sacrifices, and discoveries from across the solar system.

• Real-Time Radio: users must manually slide a frequency dial to filter out synthesized cosmic static noise and visual distortion, unlocking clear audio diaries from each spacecraft

• Interactive 3D Spacecraft Inspection: Integrates 3D models allowing students to rotate, zoom, and examine the actual engineering anatomy of each probe and rover

• The Astronaut Science Guide: Every mission page features an onboard astronaut companion who provides a dedicated audio and text breakdown explaining the real physics behind why the spacecraft never returned

• Seamless Bilingual Accessibility: Built with instant switching between English and Arabic, complete with localized voiceovers and dynamic layout adaptation, ensuring global and regional inclusivity

• Bridging Emotion and Astrophysics: Our primary objective is to transform passive, date heavy textbook learning into an emotional, hands-on scientific mystery for school-age space enthusiasts.
